spec2def(batt.dll batt.spec)

# batt.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/batt-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(batt_shims OBJECT batt.c)
target_link_libraries(batt_shims PRIVATE libsetupapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(batt_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(batt batt-cargo batt.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS batt_shims psdk)
